epics.description: This epic is for implementing the red button feature

stories.description: As a user, I want the button to be red in the UI as it increases visibility and enhances the user experience.

tasks.summary: Update CSS to set button color to red
tasks.description: Modify the CSS code to ensure that the button color is set to red in the UI.

tasks.summary: Test the Red Button in the UI
tasks.description: Write automated tests to ensure that the button appears red and functions correctly.

epics.description: This epic is for implementing the backend functionality for the red button feature

stories.summary: Update API to support Red Button
stories.description: As a backend developer, I need to update the API to support the new red button feature in the UI.

tasks.summary: Modify API response to include red button data
tasks.description: Update the API response to include data related to the red button feature.

tasks.summary: Test API changes for Red Button support
tasks.description: Write automated tests to ensure that the API supports the red button feature.

epics.description: This epic is for the UI development of the red button feature

stories.description: As a UI developer, I need to design the red button feature in the UI.

tasks.summary: Create mockups for Red Button UI
tasks.description: Design mockups for the red button feature in the UI.

tasks.summary: Review and finalize UI design for Red Button
tasks.description: Review the mockups and finalize the design for the red button feature.
